text:
Mira Chen: Hey @platform @infra @sec — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/18999 needs quick eyes before tomorrow's merge window. Small runtime + orchestration changes: eviction backoff, canary routing fallback, and KMS key rotation hook. Can someone own reviews? TL;DR below.

Mira Chen: TL;DR: touches runtime/orchestration + a small config bump to autoscaler. No model changes. Adds a fallback-model flag and a pre-rotate KMS call.

Adeel Raj: I can do platform + runtime perf quick pass this afternoon. What's the expected qps for canary?

Mira Chen: Thanks Adeel. Canary qps ~50 sustained, 200 bursts. Added perf numbers in PR description. Also included load test gist: https://gist.github.com/xyz/abc

Priya Nair: pinging infra for eviction scheduler behavior — @Jonah can you sanity-check the eviction header TTL logic? Looks like we added a jitter multiplier.

Jonah Park: Will take a look. Quick note: if jitter >2 it can delay eviction for noisy tenants. What value are we shipping? paste of config: `eviction.jitter_multiplier: 1.25`

Lex (sec): I'll look at the KMS hook. Do we have an audit trail for the pre-rotate call? Need to ensure it logs request ID + requestor.

Mira Chen: Lex good catch — PR adds structured logs at info level with request_id and user_email. Also adds metric `kms.rotate.attempts`.

merge-bot: merge-window scheduled for 2024-06-18 22:00 UTC. PR 18999 is queued. :clock1:

Adeel Raj: Quick note on perf — with `eviction.jitter_multiplier: 1.25` steady latency looks fine in my local run. Will post flamegraphs in PR.

Jonah Park: FYI I left a comment on PR about an edge-case when host is under net partition. Suggest fallback to immediate evict after X retries.

Mira Chen: Added Jonah's fallback patch to branch. Thanks. Anyone else blocking? If not, i'll request merge at EOD.

Priya Nair: +1 from platform once perf artifacts are uploaded. :thumbsup:

Lex (sec): Security +1 pending minimal changes to KMS audit formatting — will approve after I see updated logs.

Mira Chen: Will push the small log formatting tweak in 10m and tag everyone. Thanks all.
